# S61 — Split parts: lead and parts in one worktree

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

A split lets a large slice use a lead and parts with disjoint files, so parts can change different files at once. ork runs one implementer today and has no split run. The slicer contract puts the parts in the slice worktree (../slicer/src/slicer/ai.py:400), so this slice must not give each part its own worktree.
